lines.en: Fresh off the boat that carried her through seas of somewhat mandatory midday misery, Chinami Chosokabe eventually returns to her apartment to find her “Papa” wearing clothes.
This was good news. For after the “break” her friend mentioned at the end of the preceding event, there were at least five other bouts of what could only be described as “obnoxious sexual rampage.”
It appeared that the rampage had ended, thankfully. But the sadness had not.

There were other feelings as well. Confusion, mostly. The sorts of feelings anyone would get after watching a little sister take LOADS of cum from the hung guy and his MASSIVE cock for the first time.
But those would fade in time, and the worry of what might soon happen to her friend would not.
: Oh...hi.
: Chinami is very disappointed in you, Papa. You have defiled her home.
: ...What?
: You know what you did.
: Well...at least now I know how thin the walls are.
: I’m sorry you had to hear that. I needed to repair your sister. Please ignore and forget all of it.
: Chinami isn’t sure she can. Your actions have caused irreparable damage to her developing mind. You should be ashamed of yourself, Papa.
: Well, I’ve got great news for you then, Chinami. Because my shame is already infinite and being scolded by a wizard will do nothing but remind me of the walking sin that I have become.
: Where’s big sis Chika? Did you fuck her into oblivion?
: Woah. Okay. No more of that. Your sister will kill me if she hears you use that word.
: In fact, your sister will kill me if she hears you even mention that you heard anything. So just do us both a favor and repeat this to no one.
: It’s big sis Chika’s fault in the first place, Papa. She’s the one who was loud. I heard that word from her while the two of you were studying in here.
: Still, I’d prefer it if you-
: And Chinami would prefer it if the two of you didn’t lie to her just so you could spend time together. Chinami would have given you space if you asked.
: Where? You can’t go anywhere other than Tsukasa’s and that clearly didn’t help at all.
: Chinami would hide in the bathroom and put loud music on instead.
: Could you not put loud music on at Tsukasa’s place?
: Chinami wanted to, but Tsukasa wouldn’t let her! She kept listening to you two the whole time and I just had to sit there and hold my ears closed!
: Wow, this hole just keeps getting bigger. I might not even be able to climb out at this point.
: Papa made this hole when he did it with a girl in Tsukasa’s room!
: Yup. I’m stuck here forever now. Should’ve just made Chika come to me instead.
: Let the record show that Chinami is not upset about what you did today. She’s just angry that she was lied to and very confused about what happened at Tsukasa’s house.
: Good. You should be. But that doesn’t mean I’m going to talk about it with you. Which is why you should drop it and just stay uninvolved.
: I’ll be more careful with Chika in the future so you don’t have to hear it anymore. And frankly, I’m surprised she wanted to do that stuff here to begin with because of you.
: Chinami doesn’t want to be a burden like that.
: You just existing is not burdensome, Chinami. You haven’t done anything wrong.
: Chinami never does anything wrong. It’s her job to make life easier for Big Sis Chika. Which is why she talks to you about this stuff instead of her.
: Yeah, well I wish you wouldn’t talk to me about it either.
: That leaves Chinami with nobody then.
: She can’t talk to big sis Chika because she’ll get worried. And she can’t talk to Papa cause he’ll get sad. So what’s she supposed to do then? Never learn anything?
: You’re supposed to wait. You’re not ready to talk about any of this stuff yet, Chinami.
: But Tsukasa is?
: She never talked about any of that adult stuff until she saw you do it...and now, she won’t shut up about it.
: Doesn’t that make it your fault, Papa?...
: Big sis Chika too! She never lied to Chinami before she met you! Now she does it just so she can have fun for a little while!
: And Chinami understands that big sis Chika is growing up. She understands that she’d have to be lied to eventually. She doesn’t care about that.
: She just doesn’t understand why everyone starts going crazy once they meet you. You’re just a normal boy.
: I am far from normal, Chinami. That’s why I keep breaking everyone close to you.
: Is it really “breaking” them if you’re not the one hurting them, though?
: Of course I’m the one hurting them. You’ve seen what’s happened to Chika ever since she started dating me. Everything just makes her sad now because I’m not as...loyal as she wants me to be.
: I don’t know, Papa. Cause Chinami doesn’t know a lot about adult stuff, but she can definitely say that it didn’t sound like big sis Chika was hurting in here.
: That’s different, Chinami. It’s a lot easier to make someone feel good physically than it is mentally. I excel at that first part. I’m utterly horrible at the second.
: Papa makes Chinami feel good mentally all the time, though. And the way big sis Chika smiles when you’re coming over makes me think you do that for her too...
: Where’s this even going, Chinami? What do you want? Because if you’re just desperate to learn about sex, you have access to the Internet. And no, that’s not an endorsement.
: Chinami...doesn’t really know yet.
: She feels sad about a lot of things right now, but doesn’t fully understand why. It’s new...and weird.
: Welcome to the club. We’re all miserable about something. And I know I’ve been struggling to explain how I feel since before I was even your age.
: You learned about all this adult stuff before you were Chinami’s age?
: ...Yeah.
: Something like that.
: Now, are we done? Because I’d like you to go back to being the one girl that I can just entirely avoid this subject with.
: Chinami doesn’t know if that’s possible anymore, Papa...
: Wha- Chinami?!
: What are you doing here? You’re supposed to be at Tsukasa’s.
: Chinami came back when the noise stopped. She didn’t want to watch the same movies Tsukasa was.
: Noise? What noise? There was no noise. We were just studying.
: Then why are big sis Chika’s legs shaking so much?
: Because she loves to learn and there is only so much knowledge this body can hold!
: It might be time to look into soundproofing if you want to be reckless again in the future, Chika.
: I...uh...no! Tsukasa’s the rich one! She can soundproof her own room if she thinks she’s hearing things in there! Which she isn’t because nothing happened.
: A-Anyway! Do you need something? I have to leave for work in twenty minutes, but I can make you some instant ramen if you’re hungry and-
: No thank you! Chinami will wait for Papa to buy her the fancy dinner he promised as thanks for being good and giving you two alone time.
: Wait, Sensei — you did that for us? Really? That’s so sweet.
: Yes. I did this for us and Chinami is not subtly blackmailing me right now.
: Awwww! So you two are gonna hang out here while I’m at work? Have a cute little daddy-daughter dinner?
: Yup! That’s the plan! Chinami’s so excited to spend the night with her papa!
: Can’t wait. It’ll be a blast.
: You two are so cute...
: I can’t believe I doubted anything for even a second...
Chinami and I are left alone again when Chika leaves for work. And since I planned on spending the rest of the day here once I started heading over, I’m not too beaten up about this.
Sure, the amount of sex I have will exponentially decrease and reach nowhere remotely close to the sum total of all the sex ever, but it’s less travel and easier on my feet.
I just now have to figure out what to do about the demon gazing up at me and trying to figure out the best way to make me uncomfortable next.
: So! What’s Papa buying for Chinami? She wants to try eel.
: I think Chika mentioned something about there being instant ramen here. I’ll just start boiling some water and-
: Boy! Chinami sure is excited for her daddy-daughter dinner!
: It’s the one thing that will help her forget about everything that happened in this room today so she won’t blab to her big sister about it once Papa is gone!
: You continue to be the most evil person I have ever met.
: Then Chinami must take after you! There aren’t many people so evil that they’d have an affair in a little girl’s room after all.
: Chinami-
: Why did you do it? Why Tsukasa?
: Do you love her? The same way you love big sis Chika and all of the other girls Chinami always hears her complain about?
: Of course I don’t love her...that’s ridiculous.
: I was just...
: I wasn’t in the right state of mind that night. I was self-destructing and...she was the most helpless thing I could find.
: You...wanted to take her down with you then?
: No...it’s not like that either. I don’t...really know how to describe it. Why I did what I did. None of it makes any sense.
: Chinami’s helpless too, though. And the only time you’ve done adult stuff near her, you made her leave the room.
: Technically, your sister made you leave the room.
: So Papa would have let Chinami stay if the choice was his?
: Well...
: No. Probably not.
: I probably would have asked you to leave as well.
: But you weren’t there that night. Things might have been different if you were.
: That’s the part Chinami wants to understand. Because if Papa wants to do those things with Tsukasa-
: No. Chinami, that’s not what-
: Chinami thinks it’s okay.
: What?...
: Only if he’s very, very careful though! Which means none of that stuff he was doing to big sis Chika in Chinami’s house!
: Understood?
: You don’t know what you’re talking about...
: You’re right! I don’t! But if you were willing to do that stuff in front of Tsukasa, Chinami thinks you’d be willing to do it with her too!
: No. Absolutely not. Like...I’ve been alone with you before. In the bath. And none of that has ever led to-
: Papa won’t even look at Chinami in the bath, which means he’s probably trying to hide something. Like him being a lolicon.
: Wh...Why are you even bringing this up? Did Tsukasa put you up to it? Because her mother would-
: Nobody put Chinami up to anything. Tsukasa is very curious because of you, but Chinami is more worried about what will happen if somebody else gets to her first.
: What do you mean? No one’s going to get to Tsukasa first. She’s under near-constant surveillance. Anyone who’d lay a finger on her has a death wish.
: Chinami’s just saying — if Papa wanted to teach her best friend about the birds and the bees, Chinami would keep it a secret! And Tsukasa’s really into birds all of a sudden!
: Are you interested yet?
: I don’t get it...
: Did Chinami get the analogy wrong? Is it bees and something else instead?
: No, Chinami. I don’t get why you went from being completely oblivious to my sex life to trying to get me to teach your friend over the course of two hours.
: It’s not like Chinami wants to do this! She just has to!
: Why?! Don’t you understand what pushing me in this direction will do?! Don’t you know how dangerous it is for me to have an excuse for something?!
: No! Chinami just doesn’t want to lose her friend!
: So you’ll have me taxidermize her instead?! And hang onto the husk that’s left of her once I do?!
: Papa, no! Tsukasa’s mom is trying to get rid of her and Tsukasa is too stubborn to say no!
: What do you mean she’s “trying to get rid of her?”
: Tsukasa says her mom is trying to do one of those “arranged marriage” things for her...and that she might have to marry some guy she’s never even met before...
: But Chinami knows Tsukasa doesn’t want that...Tsukasa just wants to be useful to somebody and...have somebody love her and care about her.
: Chinami can’t get through to her, though...
: She won’t listen to a thing I say...
: But I want to protect her from a future she doesn’t want...because the thought of her being even more sad and alone than she is now hurts.
: What do I have to do with this though, Chinami?...
: How am I any better than some random guy?
: Chinami thinks that...Tsukasa looks up to Papa.
: That she’ll listen to his advice instead of hers.
: But...
: She also thinks that...
: It will be harder to arrange a marriage...
: If she’s already been.......
: That happens in movies sometimes...
: A man no longer wants a girl if she’s already been with another man...
: And if Papa is interested in Tsukasa like Chinami thinks he is...
: She won’t tell if he wants to be that man.
: You watch too many movies.
: If she can say no...that’s all she has to do.
: Tsubasa would never force her daughter to do something like that.
: But Tsukasa won’t say no. She refuses.
: Then...I’ll talk to her. If she really does look up to me.
: But that’s all.
: But if the two of you like each other-
: Chinami.
: That’s all.
: We’re done with this topic. Are you ready to order food?
: Papa-
: Are you ready to order food? Or do I need to start boiling some water?
: Chinami’s not a baby. She knows how to boil water...
: She’ll drop it, though...as long as you promise you’ll talk to Tsukasa.
: Fine...
: I promise.
Chinami’s affection has increased to [chinami_love]!
